name: cosmos3-nano
description: NVIDIA Cosmos 3 Nano (16B) — same Mixture-of-Transformers omni-model architecture as Super but at 8B reasoner + 8B generator scale. Fits on a single workstation-grade GPU (RTX PRO 6000 per HF model card). L0 scaffold targets text→video at 480p / 5 frames / 30 steps.
test_prompt: A robot arm carefully picks up a red cube from a table, smooth cinematic motion
skip: scaffold only — DM generator TRT graph (Phase 4) and C++ pipeline orchestration (Phase 6) not yet implemented; remove this skip once both land
notes: Nano reasoner: hidden=4096, layers=36, num_heads=32 (GQA 32:8, head_dim=128), FFN=12288. ViT shares Super's shape but out_hidden_size=4096 to match. VAE / patch / modality dims (latent_channel=48, latent_patch_size=2, max_action_dim=64, 32 embodiments) are identical to Super. This is the natural single-GPU validation target before Super's 8-GPU sweep.
